Initial verdict is mixed:

- 5 shipped surfaces, 10 classified follow-ons, zero unclassified.
- All dispositions use the closed vocabulary.
- All four named recipient missions exist.
- All five evidence hashes match current files.
- Those hashes lack repository revision pins, so write-time provenance is not established.
- The DOCUMENT checkbox legitimately changed from unchecked to checked.
- The walkthrough remains unchecked despite a heading claiming it was completed.
- Want accounting is inconsistent: two wants selected, neither reported reached or unreached, while only DOCUMENT changed in the grounded commit.

The remaining U3–U6 qualitative checks and measured baseline are explicitly listed as open work.
